notes: Same inputs/global/provider constraints within each A0/P49 comparison; three shuffled-order repeats per profile. A0 is the bounded polling/FIFO approximation, not an unmodified production binary.

Main matrix: 48 trials. A final pre-dispatch shared-subscriber cancellation check added one SQL existence check on shared operations; shared_cache was repeated for six trials and supersedes its initial six. All raw trials retained and labeled. Late error classification/dispatch DB error surfacing also finalized afterward without changing happy-path replay behavior.
C2 replay and owner C3 replay scale recorded P4.8 service times AND logical intervals 20x. SQLite and instrumentation are not scaled. This is not a live C3 latency/throughput prediction.

Quarter-second synthetic workload is unscaled C2/G6, N96. Owner C3 replay uses G9, three per source, with logical intervals corresponding to Sk1s/swoop0.1s/Octo5s. Published HTTP quotas are verified separately with mocked production adapters.

No API/network traffic. Real durable admission, claims, migrations, SQLite commits, leases and progressive results are exercised end to end with synthetic providers. No provider payloads, handles, tokens or booking selectors retained.

First result is observed persisted progress. Provider dispatch delay is relative to provider-only eligibility and includes global/fair admission wait. RSS is macOS per-process lifetime high water, not per-trial allocation; SQL time measures statement execution. CPU timing excludes initial admission although batch duration includes it.
Pre-implementation review results remain in p49_scheduler_results.json; its source hashes identify historical prototype versions, not the updated implementation source.

Fair order uses persisted dispatch_sequence across direct/shared/reprice work; new jobs enter the current round. No exactly-once upstream execution claim: a crashed worker may require upstream retries.

Finalization added an explicit actual-executor capacity clamp (matrix providers have no blocking executor), and per-provider latency quantiles computed after batch completion; neither changes matrix admission constraints. Source hashes describe the final reviewed files.
